corrected_prompt:
Photoreal POV photo, vertical 9:16, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. Look: a POV dramatization with hands only and never a face; a warm evening home office lit by a tungsten desk lamp from the left, soft shadows, natural skin; the hands always in a mustard-yellow knit sweater; muted warm palette of walnut, warm grey and mustard, the phone screen the brightest thing in the frame.
Reference images: none attached; this prompt is the only input.
Subject: one modern black smartphone, held upright by the viewer and facing the camera, centred (x 18% to 82% of the frame width) in the lower two thirds (y 34% to 96%), close to the camera; it appears once.
Hands: two adult hands seen from the viewer's own point of view, both wrists in mustard-yellow knit sleeves. The left hand holds the phone from below, four fingers around the lower back edge and the thumb on the left side. The right hand is relaxed in the lower right, entirely below the bubble: index finger and thumb relaxed, the thumb hovering about 1 cm above the lower part of the screen, frozen, touching nothing, the other three fingers loosely curled toward the palm and away from the screen. No hand or finger covers any letter of the message. Exactly two hands with five fingers each.
Action: the left hand's fingers grip the phone's lower edge; the right thumb is still, 1 cm above the glass, not touching it.
Props: the phone is a plain black smartphone with thin bezels and rounded corners, no logo on the case or the glass. Its screen is lit and shows a plain chat view on a white background with exactly one large light-grey incoming message bubble near the top of the screen, aligned to the left, and empty white space below it; no names, no avatars, no status bar, no time, no app logo.
Text: inside the one grey bubble, in dark charcoal plain sans-serif, set large on 2 or 3 lines so it reads at phone size: "We found someone cheaper." Sentence case, exactly these words and punctuation. Each line ends well before the bubble's edge. The thumb stays below the bubble; no letter touches the thumb, a finger, the hand or a sleeve.
Setting: a home office in the evening seen over the hands: a warm walnut desk below the phone, soft and out of focus, a blurred mug at the right edge, the wall behind dark warm grey and out of focus. No other screens, posters or readable words anywhere.
Camera: first person looking down at the phone at about 30 degrees, phone screen sharp, 9:16. The top 32% of the frame is a calm, dark, out-of-focus wall with nothing in it. The right 13% holds nothing important. The bottom 10% holds only hand and desk.
Continuity: none, this is the first frame of the reel.
Negatives: no face and no reflection of a face in the screen; no logo, brand or app name; no numbers, no clock, no status bar; no words other than the message; nothing in the top 32% except the calm wall; no third hand.
